notes.subject: שׁוב/יָשַׁב
notes.rationale: v45 'you turned back (תשבו)' vs v46 'you sat/dwelt (תשבו)' — same consonants, two lemmas; the echo is lost in Bambara

notes.subject: days
notes.rationale: length of stay counted in days, compared 'as the days that you dwelt'

notes.subject: Kadesi-Barne
notes.rationale: Hebrew has only 'בקדש' (Kadesh); the fuller name Kadesh-Barnea supplied in brackets as the form readers know

translation: Aw sigin Kadesi (Kadesi-Barne) yen don caman na, i n'a fɔ o donw na min na aw siginen don kɔfɛ.

tokens.gloss: i n'a fɔ o donw na
